Name: Rage Engine
Description:
Rage Engine - realistic NPC physics, injuries, gore and AI for Blade & Sorcery: Nomad.
NPCs: real hit physics, euphoria-style pain reactions, bone breaks, broken jaws, eyes that pop out and blind, teeth, bleeding, wounds, bruising, vomiting from gut shots, knockouts, dying moments, adrenaline, surrender and begging. Every NPC has a personality and a weapon proficiency (Novice to Master); escaped NPCs come back with their scars.
Serums: 13 serums and 20 super serums with powers (Wraith, Lazarus, Juggernaut, Hivemind, Magnet, Vampire, Berserker King, Deep Sleep and more) plus toxin oils and a Serum Lab. All in the item book under Rage.
Maps: 9 maps built by the mod (Rage Tower, Skybar, Rage Block NYC with a running subway, Red Room Diner, Rage Burger, Rewind Video, Starlite Arcade, Gas & Go, Club Millennium) in the level list, with the game's own wave book. Breakable glass, loose props, swinging doors.
Waves: 11 Rage waves in the wave book.
Settings (Mod Options > Rage): style presets, NPC HP, stay on feet, max NPCs, desperation, performance mode for Quest 2, per-feature toggles.
Author: Rage Engine
